content:
Today's special edition of 9to5Toys Lunch Break is here—both AirPods Pro 3 and AirPods Max 2 are down $120, marking one of the lowest prices ever; meanwhile, Best Buy has launched a one-day-only Apple sale to celebrate its 60th anniversary.

Along with AirTag 2 returning to its all-time low price, the all-new M5 Pro MacBook Pro models are $400 off today, the iPhone Air is $170 off (or you can find open-box deals with up to $406 off), plus a solid selection of discounts on official Apple accessories.
